h1: Exosome consultations for skin and hair in Cairo
answer: Exosomes are particles released by cells and are under study for aesthetic skin and hair concerns. howPerformed: Exosomes are tiny particles released by cells that carry signals between them. Their use in skin and hair treatments is still being studied, and the evidence varies by product and method.
followup: Recovery depends on how the product is applied and any procedure used alongside it. If microneedling is involved, temporary redness and sensitivity may occur. We will give you instructions for cleansing, sun protection and when to resume your usual products.
suitability: A consultation is needed for skin texture or hair thinning concerns. We first assess the likely cause, then discuss whether the proposed treatment is appropriate and what alternatives are available.
outlook: Changes, if any, can take time and vary with the product, method and individual response. We will agree on what to monitor and when to review the result.

faqs.a: Exosomes are tiny particles that help cells communicate. Products used in aesthetic treatments can differ in their source and contents, so ask about the specific product and evidence for its use.

faqs.q: Is it the same as PRP?
faqs.a: No. PRP is prepared from a sample of your own blood. Exosome products are different preparations, and their contents and evidence vary. We can explain both approaches at your consultation.
